name: Wyrm, Deepriver
body:
Deepriver Wyrm CR 8

XP 4,800
CE Huge dragon (water)
Init +5; Senses darkvision 100 ft., low-light vision; Perception +22

DEFENSE

AC 18, touch 8, flat-footed 18 (+10 natural, –2 size)
hp 100 (8d12+48)
Fort +9, Ref +6, Will +8
Immune sleep, paralysis

OFFENSE

Speed 20 ft., swim 50 ft.
Melee bite +14 (2d8+6 plus poison), slam +14 (1d8+6)
Space 20 ft.; Reach 10 ft.

STATISTICS

Str 23; Dex 10; Con 18; Int 10; Wis 12; Cha 9
Base Atk +8; CMB +13 (+17 grapple); CMD 24
Feats Improved Initiative, Iron Will, Skill Focus (Perception), Improved Natural Armor, Improved Natural Attack
Skills Perception +22, Sense Motive +8, Stealth +13; Racial Modifiers +4 Perception
Languages Draconic

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Poison (Ex)

Bite—injury; save DC 19; frequency 1/round for 6 rounds; effect 1d6 Constitution damage; cure 2 consecutive saves. The save DC is Constitution-based.

ECOLOGY

Environment temperate or cold rivers or wetlands
Organization solitary or pair
Treasure double

Deepriver wyrms are foul-smelling dragon-kin related to wyverns. They are cunning and will often use their brawn and aquatic nature to their advantage. Capable of speech, most deepriver wyrms would rather parley and manipulate humanoid targets, hoping to gain a long-term advantage over a short-term win. That said, deepriver wyrm’s diet consists of fresh fish or flesh, and these wyrms will happily devour weaker opponents.

Highly territorial over their rivers and riverbanks, wyrms will stake out their demesnes in places where they retain the advantage, but where they can exert control over their waterways. A typical deepriver wyrm’s hunting territory can be over 40 square miles of rivers and larger tributaries.

Wyrms are constantly hungry, and must consume several hundred pounds of food a day. In most rivers, this is easily met, but in difficult times deepriver wyrms have been known to come ashore to hunt.

A full-grown deepriver wyrm is about 45 feet in length, and weighs 5,000 pounds. They are dark in hue, appear worm like, and have a huge fanged maw.
